name: grievance-portal
description: Combined workspace: Backend (Express + MongoDB), GovAlert and Community_portal

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix GovAlert && npm install --prefix Community_portal
scripts.dev:backend: cd Backend && npx nodemon --ignore uploads/ index.js
scripts.vercel-install: npm install --include=dev && npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix GovAlert && npm install --include=dev --prefix Community_portal
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build --prefix GovAlert && npm run build --prefix Community_portal -- --base=/community/ && node scripts/combine-builds.mjs
